Unknown venue and artist slugs are soft 404s by design (ruled 2026-11-11): /venues/[slug] and /artists/[slug] each have a loading.tsx, so the response streams a 200 before the page's notFound() runs, and Next injects a robots noindex meta in place of the status. A real 404 would cost the loading skeleton or a request per view in the proxy. Their rows expect 200 and wait for the not-found surface. Each row asserts the injected robots noindex meta (expectMeta). /e/[id] has no loading.tsx and keeps a real 404.
